title: Engine lifecycle and the pump
preamble:
# Engine lifecycle and the pump

Engine create / destroy / pump conventions for integrators. Covers the
async-first contract, multi-engine coexistence, and the mock clock. Companion to [NFCT] (asserting / observing facts)
and [NCBK] (the action-verb surface).

## What this is not

- Not a full API reference. Signatures live in
  `runtime/include/libds.h` with
  docstrings; this doc explains *why* each call exists and *when* to call it.
- Not the realtime doc. RT-mode configuration is
  [NRTM], which states per clause what binds.
- Not a deployment guide. Production sizing and observability are integrator
  concerns out of scope.
